targets.title: Self-controlled feedback is effective if it is based on the learner’s performance.
targets.evidence_quote: We replicated their Self-Before and Self-After groups, but added a Self-Both group that was able to request feedback before a trial, but could then change or stay with their original choice after the trial.
targets.outcome_quote:
These results therefore replicate and extend the work of
Chiviacowsky and Wulf (2005)
and highlight that self-controlled learning benefits
depend
on the option of making the KR decision after completing one’s motor response.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that these results replicate and extend the target work; this overall verdict determines the outcome despite individual differences.

reasoning: A new experiment revisits the 2005 design with added groups and measures. Other references motivate or contextualize the investigation rather than being separately re-tested targets.
